Codexa Self-Stirring Glass Mug – 400 ml High-Borosilicate Glass with Heating Coaster

The Codexa Self-Stirring Glass Mug is designed for modern lifestyles where convenience, style, and innovation come together. Crafted with 400 ml high-borosilicate glass, this premium self-stirring mug ensures effortless mixing of beverages while maintaining optimal temperature using its advanced heating coaster. Whether you enjoy coffee, tea, milk, hot chocolate, or protein shakes, this rechargeable mug delivers a smooth, lump-free experience every time.

Featuring a powerful yet silent motor, the Self-Stirring Glass Mug automatically blends your drink at the press of a button. The transparent borosilicate glass not only enhances durability but also resists thermal shock, making it suitable for both hot and cold beverages. Combined with a sleek and ergonomic design, this mug is ideal for home, office, travel, and gifting.

Key Features of Codexa Self-Stirring Glass Mug

  • 400 ml High-Borosilicate Glass: Heat-resistant, scratch-resistant, and safe for daily use.
  • Automatic Self-Stirring Technology: One-touch operation for effortless mixing.
  • Heating Coaster Included: Keeps your beverage warm for longer durations.
  • Rechargeable Design: Built-in rechargeable battery for cordless convenience.
  • USB Port for Heating: Easy charging via laptop, power bank, or adapter.
  • Leak-Resistant Lid: Helps prevent spills and retains heat.
  • Quiet Motor Operation: Smooth stirring without noise disturbance.

Smart Heating & Rechargeable Convenience

The integrated heating coaster is engineered to maintain the temperature of your drink without overheating or altering its taste. Simply place the mug on the coaster, connect it using the USB port for heating, and enjoy your beverage at the perfect warmth. The rechargeable design eliminates the need for disposable batteries, making it an eco-friendly and cost-effective choice.

Unlike ordinary mugs, the offers consistent performance with long-lasting battery life. Its USB charging compatibility ensures ease of use whether you are working at your desk or relaxing at home.

Premium Build for Everyday Use

Made from high-borosilicate glass, this mug withstands high temperatures and sudden temperature changes. The transparent body adds a modern aesthetic while allowing you to visually enjoy your beverage as it stirs automatically. The ergonomic handle provides a comfortable grip, ensuring safety and ease during use.

The Self-Stirring Glass Mug is ideal for mixing coffee with sugar, milk with supplements, tea with honey, or even instant soups. It saves time and eliminates the need for spoons, making it perfect for busy professionals and students.

Perfect for Gifting & Daily Lifestyle

With its premium design and smart functionality, the makes an excellent gift for birthdays, corporate events, festivals, or special occasions. It is suitable for coffee lovers, tech enthusiasts, and anyone who appreciates practical innovation. Easy to clean and maintain, this is designed for long-term use. Simply hand wash the glass body and avoid immersing the electronic base in water to ensure optimal performance.

Why Choose Codexa?

  • Trusted quality with premium materials
  • Advanced self-stirring and heating technology
  • Energy-efficient rechargeable system
  • Modern design with practical usability
  • Ideal for home, office, and gifting

Upgrade your beverage experience with the and enjoy perfectly mixed, warm drinks anytime. Designed for convenience, built for durability, and styled for modern living, this mug is the smart choice for everyday comfort.
